name: Kombai
tagline: AI frontend agent that turns Figma, images, and prompts into production React code.
description: Kombai is a domain-specialized AI agent for frontend development that converts Figma designs, images, and text prompts into production-ready React and HTML. It scans your repository to match your stack and conventions, applies best practices across 400+ frontend libraries, and pairs a design canvas with code generation and in-browser refinement. On its internal 200+ task benchmark it reports a 96% compilation success rate.
insight: Raised $4.5M led by Stellaris Venture Partners.
edge: Frontend-only specialist that reads your repo and applies conventions for 400+ UI libraries, where general coding agents produce generic components.
pros: Canvas design and code in one loop
